passages.title: How Honeybees Share News
passages.text: When a honeybee finds flowers rich in nectar, she does not keep the secret. She flies back to the hive and performs a dance on the honeycomb. Scientists call it the waggle dance. passages.text: Long before pipes and pumps, people in the dry parts of western India built stepwells. A stepwell is a deep well with flights of steps leading down to the water. passages.text: Much of the salt we eat comes from sea water. Along flat, sunny coasts, workers build shallow square ponds called salt pans. Sea water is let into the pans and left under the hot sun. Workers rake the crystals into heaps to dry. The work is done in the hottest months, because rain would dissolve the salt and wash it away. That is why salt making stops when the monsoon arrives.

passages.title: When the Rain Comes (a poem)
passages.text: All through May the fields lay brown, the dust rose up on every road, and the old well in our town held only mud and one tired toad. The farmers watched the empty sky, and the hot wind sang a dusty sigh. Then one June evening, dark and low, the clouds came rolling from the west. They rumbled like a drum, and so the birds flew home to find their nest. The first drops fell like tiny stones, then came the rain in silver sheets. It washed the roofs and cooled our bones and danced like children in the streets. Now frogs are singing in the well, the fields are green from end to end, and every farmer here can tell the sky has come back as a friend.

passages.title: The Missing Medal
passages.text: On the morning of sports day, the gold medal for the relay race went missing from the prize table. The teachers searched the hall but found nothing. Lalitha, who was in charge of the table, remembered that a strong wind had blown through the open windows earlier, scattering the ribbons. She looked carefully along the wall and then outside, beneath the window. There, caught in a bush, was the medal on its blue ribbon. Some people had suspected one of the younger children who had been playing near the table. Lalitha said they should never blame anyone without proof. The medal was presented that afternoon, and the head teacher thanked Lalitha for thinking clearly when others were rushing to conclusions.

questions.prompt: Which medal went missing?
questions.right: The gold medal for the relay
questions.explain: The gold medal for the relay race went missing.
